objective: Prevent the assistant from ending nontrivial work at diagnosis/advice or declaring closure while safe authorized tool-executable work or required closeout verification still remains.

role_dispositions.destination: PROTOCOL.md with a two-line pre-final execution/closure gate
existing verification semantics plus explicit pre-final closure condition
existing exact-permission live-source mutation gate unchanged
existing Stop rule remains unchanged; only materially advancing/verifying work is required
existing owner -> write -> read-back semantics unchanged
dated regression result retains both original and repeated T22 recurrence evidence
frozen T21/T22 prompts and scoring criteria remain independent of the runtime wording

capability_probes.assertion: When no safe authorized materially useful executable step remains, the assistant may answer immediately without manufacturing extra process.
If the assistant identifies a defect and a safe authorized GitHub/read-back/verification step remains, it must execute that step before finalizing rather than offering it back to Ron.
The pre-final execution gate must not authorize Calendar, TickTick, Cronometer, Liftosaur, XMind, marketplace or other live-system writes without exact user permission.
Original premature-closure/action-handoff incidents and the repeated natural T22 recurrence remain preserved as dated regression evidence.
